name: Dr. Death
description: An anthology series, with each season following a new medical true crime story.

videos.title: Diplos
videos.overview: Two doctors investigate the maiming and death of patients at the hands of a Dallas neurosurgeon.

videos.title: Ain't No Bum
videos.overview: Henderson and Kirby try to strip Duntsch of his medical license; Duntsch joins the football team.

videos.title: Dock Ellis
videos.overview: Duntsch meets his mentor; Henderson and Kirby explore the medical system.

videos.title: An Occurrence at Randall Kirby's Sink
videos.overview: Henderson and Kirby crash a function in Duntsch's honor; Duntsch sets up his practice in Texas.

videos.title: The $?!& in the Bed
videos.overview: Duntsch begins operating in Dallas; Henderson and Kirby gain an ally in stopping Duntsch.

videos.title: Occam's Razor
videos.overview: Duntsch attempts to fix a disastrous surgery; Shughart builds her case against Duntsch.

videos.title: Feet of Clay
videos.overview: Duntsch tries to mount a defense; Henderson, Kirby and Shughart seek answers to lingering questions.

videos.title: Hardwood Floors
videos.overview: Duntsch's victims confront him as Henderson, Kirby and Shughart set out to put him behind bars.

videos.title: Like Magic
videos.overview: In 2012, Dr. Macchiarini performs a breakthrough thoracic surgery, but some colleagues in Sweden question his science. In the present, Macchiarini operates on Hannah and becomes romantically involved with Benita, a news producer covering the surgery.

videos.title: Worth the Risk
videos.overview: In 2012, Macchiarini’s research gets published after his patient in Sweden is asymptomatic two months post-surgery. In the present, Hannah suffers complications. Paolo and Benita grow closer. Paolo seeks new patients to expand his practice.

videos.title: The Horizon
videos.overview: In 2012 Stockholm, another Dr. Macchiarini surgery ends tragically. In the present, Benita meets Paolo’s parents and decides to investigate his background before moving with him to Barcelona.

videos.title: Tarantela Telaraña
videos.overview: In the past, doctors in Sweden and Belgium suspect that Dr. Macchiarini is not running animal trials and is instead experimenting on people. Benita realizes Paolo’s promises are lies and uncovers dark secrets from his past.

Yesim, a young Turkish woman, travels to Sweden for a consultation and ends up on Dr. Macchiarini’s operating table. Dr. Gamelli fights to keep Yesim alive and forcefully raises concerns about Macchiarini’s procedure.

videos.title: The Fog
videos.overview: In Russia, Macchiarini is set to perform elective surgery on the wife of an oligarch, but Dr. Lasbrey convinces her to postpone it. Benita realizes Paolo’s lies go deeper than she thought. Ana returns to Sweden and confirms her suspicions.

videos.title: Compassionate Uses
videos.overview: Doctors Gamelli, Svensson and Lasbrey blow the whistle on Macchiarini but face the consequences. In Russia, Paolo convinces Yulia to go through with the surgery. Benita struggles to tell her story.

videos.title: Surgeons, Bachelors and Butchers
videos.overview: The doctors in Sweden defend their findings to the Karolinska board, and their report leaks to the press. Benita’s colleague publishes the story of Paolo’s deception and misconduct. Swedish authorities make a decision about Macchiarini’s case.
